`jfk.wav`: 11 s from John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address (a US government work, public
domain), 16 kHz mono, as shipped in whisper.cpp's samples.

`conversation.wav` / `.json`: a 42 s three-way "conversation" for diarization tests, built from
LibriSpeech test-clean (CC BY 4.0, Panayotov et al. 2015): utterances of speakers 1320, 2961 and
7127 taking turns A B A C B C A B with 0.3 s gaps. The JSON holds each turn's speaker, times and
reference text.
